description: The store's profile and the rules every module follows.

profile.title: Store profile
profile.description: How the store presents itself across the dashboard and on Invoices.

money.title: Currency and VAT
money.description: How every price, payment and report is written and taxed.

stock.title: Stock and Returns
stock.description: When stock leaves the shelves, and how long Customers have to send items back.

defaults.title: New Users
defaults.description: What a new User starts with. Each User can change their own afterwards.

hints.currencyCode: The Store currency's three-letter ISO code, for example USD or EUR. There are no exchange rates: changing it relabels amounts, it doesn't convert them.
hints.currencySymbol: How amounts are written on screen, for example $ or €.
hints.vatRate: Added to taxable Products, whose prices are entered without VAT. An Order line keeps the rate it was priced with, so a change never alters past Orders.
hints.deductionStage: Confirming an Order reserves its units. At this Order status the Reserved units leave On-hand; cancelling before it puts them back.
hints.returnWindow: How many days after delivery a Customer may request a Return.
hints.lowStockThreshold: What a new Variant starts with. When a Variant's Available stock in a Warehouse drops to it or below, a low-stock alert fires.
hints.logo: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MB. A square image looks best.

preparing.label: Preparing
preparing.description: As soon as packing starts. On-hand matches the shelves earliest.

ready_for_shipping.label: Ready for shipping
ready_for_shipping.description: Once the parcel is packed and waiting for the Carrier.

shipped.label: Shipped
shipped.description: When the parcel leaves the Warehouse. Cancelling stays free of stock corrections longest.

preview.title: How amounts will look
preview.invalid: Enter a valid currency code and VAT rate to see a preview.

logo.type: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
logo.tooLarge: Choose an image of 1 MB or less.

validation.email: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
validation.currencyCode: Use the three-letter ISO code in capitals, for example USD.
validation.currencySymbol: Enter a symbol of up to 8 characters.
validation.vatRate: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, with up to two decimals.
validation.returnWindow: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 365.
validation.lowStockThreshold: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100,000.
